description: This file defines a report parser class for generating account balance reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for retrieving fiscal year and period information, and processing account data for reporting.

classes.name: account_balance
classes.description: Parser class for account balance report, extending report_sxw.rml_parse, providing methods to generate report data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the parser, sets up local context with helper methods and variables.

methods.name: get_fiscalyear
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the fiscal year given its ID from the form data.

methods.name: get_periods
methods.description: Retrieves a string listing the period names based on form data, either from provided period IDs or from the fiscal year's periods.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates a list of account lines with hierarchical processing, summing debits and credits, and filtering based on display options.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Returns the total sum of credits accumulated.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Returns the total sum of debits accumulated.
